description_en: Queries the restorable time ranges for ApsaraDB for MongoDB sharded cluster instances that use cloud disks
description_zh: 查询云数据库 MongoDB 版云盘版分片集群实例的可恢复时间
name: DescribeClusterRecoverTime

parameters.help_en:
The region of the source instance for geo-redundancy backups.

This parameter is required when you query geo-redundancy backups
parameters.help_zh:
异地备份源实例所在区域。

当查询的是异地备份时，需要且必填
parameters.name: src_region

parameters.help_en:
The region where the geo-redundancy backup set is stored.

This parameter is required when you query geo-redundancy backups
parameters.help_zh:
异地备份备份集所在地域。

当查询的是异地备份时，需要且必填
parameters.name: dest_region

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to query only the restorable time ranges that support database and table restoration. Valid values:
true: returns only the restorable time ranges that support database and table restoration.
false (default): returns all restorable time ranges
parameters.help_zh:
是否仅查询支持库表恢复的可恢复时间段。取值：
true：仅返回支持库表恢复的可恢复时间段。
false（默认值）：返回全部可恢复时间段
parameters.name: only_db_table_recovery

RestoreRanges.description_en: The list of cluster backup sets. A cluster backup contains the backup sets of each node
RestoreRanges.description_zh: 集群备份集列表。集群备份里面包含每个节点的备份集

RestoreBeginTime.description_en: The start time of the restorable time range. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
RestoreBeginTime.description_zh: 可恢复开始时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

RestoreEndTime.description_en: The end time of the restorable time range. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
RestoreEndTime.description_zh: 可恢复结束时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

RestoreType.description_en:
The restoration method. Valid values:
PointInTime (default): point-in-time restoration
RestoreType.description_zh:
恢复方式，取值说明：
PointInTime（默认）：基于时间点恢复
